question: A boat can travel with a speed of 15 km/hr in still water. If the speed of the stream is 5 km/hr, find the time taken by the boat to go 80 km downstream.
solution:
Given:

A boat can travel at a speed of 15 km/hr in still water.

The speed of the stream is 5 km/hr

Concept used:

Downstream speed = Boat speed + speed of the current

Distance = speed × time

Calculation:

Downstream speed will be 

⇒ 15 + 5 = 20 km

So, the time taken will be 

⇒ 80 / 20 = 4 hr

∴ The correct option is 2
